scope: Read-only C01 remaining 24 FX original-source and runtime-contract audit; no artwork generation, production exporter changes, manifest edits, or worktree operations.

commonContract.orderMeaning: Authored board row columns left to right, inferred phase labels below are visual audit labels, not pre-existing manifest frame names.
commonContract.runtimePlacement: BoardView places effect at target cell centre.
commonContract.effectiveBlendMode: Normal source-over by default. FX metadata blendMode is not forwarded to BoardStrip; no additive/screen setting exists on BoardStrip.
commonContract.lastFrameBehavior: FrameAnimationController holds the fourth frame after clip completes until effect drawing is removed.
commonContract.hitOverlay: BoardView additionally overlays a white circle with initial alpha 0.65 and animated opacity plus damage number. Do not bake this independent burst into the FX art.
commonContract.runtimeTextureSource: candidate01Asset resolves runtime-hd/fx/fx-NN.png for all 24; logical coordinates stay 32x32. Pixi slices physical image width/4; SVG displays the HD image in logical strip bounds.

sourceMapping.legacyCropFormula: [round(col*W/4)+5, round(row*H/4)+5, round((col+1)*W/4)-5, round((row+1)*H/4)-5], Python round (ties to even)
sourceMapping.integrityCaveat: Legacy builder references missing assets/manifest-complete.json. Mapping is reconstructed from surviving builder numeric board/row order, catalog topic order, visible source semantics, and byte-level runtime reconstruction from existing intermediate alpha. Canonical pending-redraw source-missing flags are stale for board availability, but the original topic manifest is still absent.
sourceMapping.chromaCaveat: Original-to-intermediate chroma key was not rerun: it invokes an external helper and mutates repository intermediates. Source boards and cached alpha were inspected, hashed and slot-linked; exact reconstruction verification starts at the surviving cached alpha and executes the documented subsequent transformations in memory only.

pilot.reason: First-level c01.border-blade is used by Laiya and swordsmen; simple readable four-phase crescent affords direct proof of original-order motion, shared registration, normal compositing, and target-centred hit playback.
pilot.geometryPolicy: Retain 32x32 logical cells, 128x32/256x64 strip outputs, 12fps, non-loop and normal source-over. Use a single authored canvas, common transform and stable pivot across all four phases; do not use alpha-bbox fit.
pilot.pivotDecision: First unify the single pivot owner in a behavior-preserving engineering change: correct the 24 manifest anchors to actual [16,16] and make the renderer consume anchor. Keep all existing output positions [-16,-16]. Regress every topic and a non-centered test anchor; the FX-01 pilot then targets the declared [16,16] anchor without any competing fallback.
pilot.renderReview: At actual scene size evaluate all 4 frames and 0..420ms sequence over bright stone, dark earth and green ground, with normal hit circle/number present. Check that growth is visible and final fragments are unobtrusive during held-final-frame interval.
pilot.nextOptional: FX-17 heal exercises legitimate glow/translucent phase export after the slash pilot is accepted; do not include it in the first pilot by default.
